invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of .execute(), which should not be null if the executor executed successfully.
The getWriteStatuses() method on the HoodieWriteMetadata result should return a non-null List.
The size of the returned WriteStatuses list is always non-negative.
Partition write stats are part of the result metadata and should not be null if result is not null.
instantTime is a required argument for bulk insert and should not be null.
